title: Sharks: The monsters tamed
content: Peter Benchley(1940-2006) and Steven Spielberg taught us to fear sharks. But this video presents a different image of them.When Benchley later saw how "Jaws" led to the wanton destruction of sharks, he said: "[T]he shark in an updatedJawscould not be the villain; it would have to be written as the victim;  for, worldwide, sharks are much more the oppressed than the oppressors."Direct link to YouTube video.
